test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The sum of three numbers x, y and z is 12 and their squares sum is 20. What will be the value of x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct combined **algebraic identity**:

Value = (x + y + z) × [3(x² + y² + z²) − (x + y + z)²] ÷ 2

Value = 12 × [3(20) − (12)²] ÷ 2

Value = 12 × [60 − 144] ÷ 2 = 12 × (−84) ÷ 2

Value = 12 × (−42) = −504

**∴ The correct answer is −504.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sum of numbers **(x + y + z) = 12** and sum of their squares **(x² + y² + z²) = 20**.

We know the **expansion formula**:

(x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx)

⇒ (12)² = 20 + 2(xy + yz + zx)
⇒ 144 − 20 = 2(xy + yz + zx)
⇒ 124 = 2(xy + yz + zx)
⇒ **xy + yz + zx = 62**

Now, to find the value of **x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz**, use the standard **algebraic identity**:

x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x² + y² + z² − (xy + yz + zx))

⇒ Value = 12 × (20 − 62)
⇒ Value = 12 × (−42)
⇒ Value = −504

**∴ The correct answer is −504.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Special Case: x + y + z = 0

If the sum of three numbers is zero, then **x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz**.

Alternative form of the identity

x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = (1/2)(x + y + z)[(x − y)² + (y − z)² + (z − x)²], which is useful when differences between numbers are given.

Identity for squares

x² + y² + z² − xy − yz − zx = (1/2)[(x − y)² + (y − z)² + (z − x)²].</p
